title.zh: Anthropic预览主动式智能体Claude Duet
title.en: Anthropic previews proactive agent Claude Duet

summary.zh: Anthropic预览主动式智能体Claude Duet；Mistral发布Large 4开源权重模型。
summary.en: Anthropic previewed Claude Duet, a proactive agent, and Mistral released its Large 4 open-weight model.

summary.zh: 巴克莱计划削减5000个与AI相关的岗位；有报道称OpenAI在IPO前寻求融资300亿美元。
summary.en: Barclays planned 5,000 AI-linked job cuts, and OpenAI was reported to be raising $30 billion ahead of an IPO.

title.zh: 特朗普称未与伊朗谈判 问题将“很快”解决
title.en: Trump says US not negotiating with Iran

summary.zh: 特朗普表示美国没有与伊朗谈判，但问题将“相当快”得到解决。
summary.en: Trump said the US was not negotiating with Iran and a resolution would come "fairly soon."

title.zh: 土耳其、卡塔尔、印尼、巴基斯坦签署“巴德尔”防务合作备忘录
title.en: Türkiye, Qatar, Indonesia, Pakistan sign Badr defense memorandum

summary.zh: 四国签署“巴德尔”防务合作谅解备忘录。
summary.en: Türkiye, Qatar, Indonesia and Pakistan signed the Badr defense-cooperation memorandum.

title.zh: 达曼法赫德国王国际机场遇袭致1死8伤
title.en: Attack on Dammam airport kills one

summary.zh: 沙特达曼法赫德国王国际机场遇袭，造成1人死亡、8人受伤。
summary.en: An attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam killed one and injured eight.

title.zh: AI支出担忧再起 纳指重挫2.6%
title.en: Nasdaq tumbles 2.6% on AI spending worries

summary.en: The Nasdaq fell 2.6% to 26,008.86 on Oct. 22 and the S&P 500 1.21% as AI doubts revived and oil jumped.

title.zh: 西藏那曲巴青县发生7.0级地震 国家启动四级应急响应

summary.zh: 10月22日22时33分，西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，震源深度10公里，国家启动地震灾害四级应急响应。
summary.en: A magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Baqen County in Nagqu, Tibet at 22:33 on Oct. 22 at a depth of 10 km; a level-4 national emergency response was launched.

body.zh:
据应急管理部消息，10月22日22时33分西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，震源深度10公里。国务院抗震救灾指挥部办公室、应急管理部启动国家地震灾害四级应急响应，派出工作组赶赴震区。

据后续报道，截至10月24日地震已造成16人遇难、76人受伤，1.2万余人转移安置，三轮排查未发现失联人员。（据中国经济网）
